genre_target: Statement of Purpose (SoP) / Research Statement / 学术自我介绍
domain_context: 雅思小作文动态/静态图表与实证数据综述
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写申请博士/博后/访问学者或个人学术主页的 Research Statement / SoP 核心段：把我已经做过的深度学习/时间序列/生成模型工作，与我未来想探索的具身智能（Embodied AI）无缝串联成一条充满内驱力的科研主线。
prompt_zh: 【表达意图→段落构建 1】假设你正在撰写【Statement of Purpose (SoP) / Research Statement / 学术自我介绍】。你这一段的核心表达意图是：“我这一段想写申请博士/博后/访问学者或个人学术主页的 Research Statement / SoP 核心段：把我已经做过的深度学习/时间序列/生成模型工作，与我未来想探索的具身智能（Embodied AI）无缝串联成一条充满内驱力的科研主线。”。请严格按照 `BP48` 的逐句功能骨架（4 步法）与逻辑法则 `L018`（口头学术演讲的听觉信息流：短分句、视觉锚点与设问引导（Oral Signposting）），写出一段 4–5 句、零 AI 痕迹、主语紧凑（≤6词）的自然英文段落。
source_material_or_draft: Since I was a child, I have been fascinated by artificial intelligence and robots. In my master's degree, I did some research on time series forecasting and published a paper. In the future, I want to study embodied AI because it is a very hot topic and can help humans a lot.
structural_constraints: S1 [过往研究主线凝练 Past Research Thread]：My prior research has centered on modeling non-stationary dynamics and uncertainty in high-dimensional sequential data.

S2 [代表作攻克过程与硬核成果 Concrete Achievement]：In my recent work on [Time Series / Generative Modeling], I observed that [Core Bottleneck], which led me to formulate [Method]—reducing long-horizon drift by [X%] across industrial telemetry benchmarks.

S3 [向具身智能跃迁的科学顿悟 Scientific Pivot to Embodied AI]：While passive sequence forecasting predicts how an environment evolves, physical decision-making requires closing the loop: actions actively alter future state distributions.

S4 [未来研究愿景 Future Research Agenda]：Building on my foundation in continuous-time generative modeling, my doctoral/future research aims to develop sample-efficient visuomotor world models that enable robots to adapt online to non-stationary contact dynamics.
target_defects_to_fix: 口语化严重 + 缺失比较基准与维度（Colloquialism & Imprecision）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

S4 [阶段 3 解码与闭环输出 Stage 3 Decoding]：Finally, the [Module 3] integrates $\mathbf{Z}^{(2)}$ with [Prior/Scale Cue] to output the final [Prediction/Action Trajectory].

source_material_or_draft: Since I was a child, I have been fascinated by artificial intelligence and robots. In my master's degree, I did some research on time series forecasting and published a paper. In the future, I want to study embodied AI because it is a very hot topic and can help humans a lot.
structural_constraints: S1 [过往研究主线凝练 Past Research Thread]：My prior research has centered on modeling non-stationary dynamics and uncertainty in high-dimensional sequential data.

S2 [代表作攻克过程与硬核成果 Concrete Achievement]：In my recent work on [Time Series / Generative Modeling], I observed that [Core Bottleneck], which led me to formulate [Method]—reducing long-horizon drift by [X%] across industrial telemetry benchmarks.

S3 [向具身智能跃迁的科学顿悟 Scientific Pivot to Embodied AI]：While passive sequence forecasting predicts how an environment evolves, physical decision-making requires closing the loop: actions actively alter future state distributions.

S4 [未来研究愿景 Future Research Agenda]：Building on my foundation in continuous-time generative modeling, my doctoral/future research aims to develop sample-efficient visuomotor world models that enable robots to adapt online to non-stationary contact dynamics.
